results.content:
Title: Intent Data Tells You Who’s Interested. Network Signals Tell You What to Do Next. | Commsor Blog
Intent Data Tells You Who’s Interested. Network Signals Tell You What to Do Next. # Intent Data Tells You Who’s Interested. Network Signals Tell You What to Do Next. Network signals reveal the warm paths that turn static data into real conversations. This piece breaks down how intent data lost its edge, why network signals are the missing link, and how modern GTM teams are combining both to win faster, warmer deals. Network signals reveal the warm paths that turn static data into real conversations. This piece breaks down how intent data lost its edge, why network signals are the missing link, and how modern GTM teams are combining both to win faster, warmer deals. Everyone’s got intent data, maybe your team is using Vector, Bombora, 6sense, Influ2, or other competitors. And intent data is great, it shows you who might be ready to buy. That’s where network signals come in. ## The Rise (and Plateau) of Intent Data. These breadcrumbs became what we know as *intent data*. Intent data worked wonders in the early 2010s when few teams used it. A recent LinkedIn study found that 72% of buyers now ignore outreach that references surface-level intent signals because it feels impersonal. When every team has the same signals, intent data stops being a competitive advantage and starts being table stakes. Intent data shows interest signals. Despite widespread adoption, only 30% of B2B marketers use intent data across the full funnel (Zymplify). Intent data shows you who’s knocking, and network signals hand you the key. Network signals show that your advisor’s former colleague works there. Network signals identify overlaps across your company’s graph; employees, investors, advisors, and customers; and map them to your target accounts. When paired with intent data, network signals turn awareness into opportunity. Network signals are real-time insights into who in your extended network can get you into your target accounts. When paired with intent data, sellers can prioritize warm accounts. Here’s an example flow of combining intent data with network signals:. Network signals make each and every data point actionable. Don’t stop using intent data, make it mean something. Want to turn your intent data into intros?
